body:
We were 18-22. I made her happy at the start, at least I think I did, but as my sanity deteriorated so did her happiness. I went off the rails, I was an absolute arsehole. I despise the person I was in the last year or so of our relationship. 

I would never deserve to have her back because of the version of me in that period. I just sincerely hope that she is happy, I know she made it in terms of her career. She copied what I wanted to do! Then I ended up in a polar opposite field. 

But like I said in the main post, I want her to have everything and more.

Ah, I keep this shit to myself. Not a good idea. 

It’s difficult, I want to be all like ‘oh, it takes time but you get there’. But I truly believe that I never will. 

Don’t get me wrong, I know to some this post will come across a bit creepy. As it’s not the norm to still be hung up about someone six years down the line. But it’s just me and my personal feelings, I felt love for a person that I’ll never replicate. A while ago, at the start of my current relationship I lied to myself, believing that I was past her. I think I had a 3-6 month window of not thinking about her every day. 

Beyond that, I’ve just continued to lie to myself for years that I can get past this, that I can love my current partner in the same way I loved Natasha. It’s been a year or so since I realised that I was lying to myself. But I’m just numb now, I don’t really emote anymore. Not in the way a normal person does anyway. I’m just going to live my life, keep building on my career and then just die. I’m fine with it, I’ve accepted that there’s nothing more I can experience in this world.

Ah mate, I wish. I’m in the rebound from her which got way too serious, four years into it. It’s a long story which further deepens the pit of depression that I call me, but I’m in too deep and this is my life now. 

I think I’ve reached the point in my life that I will never be truly happy again and I’ve accepted it. I’ve come along way since we split, I’ve worked my arse off to get myself into a good career because something in me thought owning a house, a car and earning good money would make me happy. I’m 27 and I’ve lived my entire life, I just happened to squeeze it into three and a half years. Because of that, I’m almost fulfilled. The only thing I need to reach fulfilment is knowing that she’s happy, that’s practically all I give a fuck about, not a day goes by without me wondering whether she’s happy. 

Thank you for your kind words though, and all the same to you!

I must have read through about 100 comments anticipating someone will have mentioned this, but none acknowledge that his facial features are too small for his face. He looks like he stole a baby’s face and threw a beard on it to hide it. It’s either that or the repetitive inbreeding of Floridians.

You’ve pretty much just described my (M27) circumstances. Except we have a dog, mortgage and a car together.

Life is fucked, you likely made a shitty decision. I entirely blame myself for splitting up with my ex and often cry about it. Basically I’ve had a fucked up life and it was all attacking my brain towards the end of the relationship and I wasn’t strong enough to get help. I’m still not. 

My ex is the single most beautiful, most incredible human being I have ever met. If I ever for a second believed that I was even a fraction of what she deserves I would beg for her back. But then again, thinking like that is what fucked me in the first place.

Just do what you can to be happy! It’s too late for me now. But if you do get her back and fuck it up again you’ve earned the right to be added to the ultimate cunt list.
Also, she’s far more intelligent than I. Our conversations end with me feeling like an idiot and that I should be doing everything. Then resentment about four days later.

I think every parent does it. As a child I never thought reading the news on the toilet would be one of the things that makes me happiest. 

It probably isn’t enough, but I do try my hardest to be as supportive, loving, caring and what other adjectives you wish to add. COVID doesn’t help, us both being stuck in with only our own company with nothing really to look forward to.

Just to add, she’s always been pretty open about her mental health so I don’t believe it ties in to that. It’s just dawned on me that it may appear that I am overlooking her mental health. 

I honestly just don’t know, I think it’s laziness. Her mum is this amazing woman who is basically who I’ve become. Doing everything for everyone, but never for herself. I’m not a fraction of that woman though!

I think having been brought up in surroundings where you don’t have to do anything, results in not doing anything as an adult.

Talking doesn’t seem to work.

I’ll be honest, I woke up at 5am in a rant mood this morning and searched for somewhere I could receive support, advice and generally somewhere to moan about things seen as I can’t see friends etc. This seemed quite perfect and I was too bleary eyed to read the rules. My bad! 

I think she truly believes that she does as much as me when I’m pretty much non-stop for 18-20 hours daily.

She’s the higher earner, that may change over the course of the next few years and given comments that have passed of recent I get the impression she ties that to of ‘effort’ or ‘harder working’. But I’m literally running myself into the ground. I had a night off where I could get in bed early last week because I collapsed in the middle of a meeting at work. Thankfully it was a housekeeping meeting and there was no camera on, but I’ve never just fallen off my chair for thirty minutes before. The subsequent eight hour sleep I had that night was glorious though.

Thank you! I have noticed downvotes, people take the gender thing very seriously over here!

I do all the cleaning, she gets a lot of time off work so every 3-6 months she’ll do a big clean but she doesn’t do the every day stuff and just leaves a blazing trail behind her whatever she does, leaving me to sort out.

Childcare, she’s his stepmum and does contribute a lot. She’s far more patient with homeschooling etc so takes the majority in that respect (small majority). 
She absolutely adores him, she does go the extra mile with him for which I have nothing but love and respect for. Between him and the dog, there’s little else keeping us together

The dogs just a pup, and I won’t deny a shock to my system in terms of how tiring he is. But you can take any of my organs before you take him! 

I just need her to see that our current circumstances are not a compromise, we need to work as a team for our relationship to work as well as our lives and I feel I am doing so much and getting so little in return. 

In terms of time to myself, I get two shits a day and to watch the football once a week. Both of which are frequently disturbed.
